overview.executiveSummary: Shanghai is a provisional destination and 15–22 February 2027 is a working seven-night comparison window for two adults, not a booking. One official date-specific hotel quote is available: The Peninsula Shanghai’s Deluxe Room, one king bed, at CNY 2,465 average per night on a non-refundable offer, or CNY 2,900 average per night on flexible/other displayed rates. Both displayed rates exclude taxes and fees, so no all-in hotel total is verified. The room information and 2025 hotel fact sheet document a king option, two-adult capacity and marble bathroom, but the final booking still needs a payable total. Other candidates have verified room/location/amenity details but no comparable dated rate. Current 2026 Michelin Guide distinctions and several 2026 menu prices are documented below; they are not promises for February 2027. No subway/bus journey-time matrix was verified, so hotels are deliberately unranked and no one-hour Michelin density is claimed.
overview.holidayContext: The official 2027 schedule lists the Spring Festival break as 5–13 February, with 14 February a make-up workday. The working check-in date is 15 February, after that break; this does not guarantee hotel pricing, restaurant opening, or attraction schedules.

findings.title: One dated hotel quote; no verified all-in bill
findings.text: The Peninsula quote is for 15–22 February 2027, two adults, one room and a king bed. CNY 2,465 × 7 = CNY 17,255 before taxes/fees on the non-refundable offer; CNY 2,900 × 7 = CNY 20,300 before taxes/fees on the flexible Premier Rate. These are arithmetic from displayed average nightly rates, not checkout totals.

findings.title: No defensible overall hotel rank yet
findings.text: Langham, Bvlgari and Ritz-Carlton do not have a comparable dated official rate. The one-hour public-transit restaurant catchment is also unverified. Property-area convenience and on-site dining are shown as context, not as a transit score.

findings.title: Six current 2026-starred restaurants in this researched set
findings.text: The 2026 Guide pages show T’ang Court (2 stars), Bao Li Xuan (2), Yi Long Court (1), Jin Xuan (1), Taian Table (3) and Fu He Hui (2). Sir Elly’s is listed in the 2026 Guide, but the captured page shows no star icon. Il Ristorante – Niko Romito’s Shanghai Guide distinction was not verified and is not counted.

findings.title: Menus are useful 2026 snapshots, not 2027 guarantees
findings.text: Official menu prices support example set-menu totals for two at T’ang Court, Bao Li Xuan, Il Ristorante, Yi Long Court and Sir Elly’s. Taian Table’s current FAQ lists base tasting-menu prices and says add-ons can increase the bill. Menu versions, opening days and availability must be rechecked before reserving.

findings.title: Museum weekly schedules are published; 2027 operation still needs a final check
findings.text: The People’s Square museum is normally closed Monday; Shanghai Museum East is normally closed Tuesday. The published current schedule maps to the sample week, but future holiday, exhibition and opening-hour changes must be checked before visiting.

activities.name: Shanghai Museum East
activities.dateFit: Using the published weekly schedule only: open Mon 15 Feb; closed Tue 16 Feb; open Wed 17–Mon 22 Feb 2027. This is a calendar mapping, not a future operating confirmation.
activities.optionalCosts: Audio guide: CNY 20 for Chinese or CNY 40 for English per set for permanent exhibitions; smart audio for special exhibitions may cost extra.
activities.reservation: Individual reservation is generally not required. Advance reservations are required for The Curio-City and Digital Gallery; special exhibitions may be ticketed. Groups of 20+ require a phone reservation seven days ahead.

suggestions.title: Keep the sample dates, but treat the Peninsula number as pre-tax only
suggestions.text: If considering the current New Year offer, first ask the hotel to confirm the Deluxe Room’s private bathroom, the exact all-in total for two adults and seven nights, and the precise ‘Book before 8 Dec’ cutoff. Compare the non-refundable terms against the flexible rate before deciding.

suggestions.title: Request same-date quotes from all four hotels
suggestions.text: Use 15–22 February 2027, two adults, one room, one king bed, private bathroom, seven nights, and request a final payable total with taxes/fees and cancellation terms. Do not rank hotels until the missing quotes are comparable.

suggestions.title: Build the Michelin score only after route checks
suggestions.text: For each hotel and restaurant, save a dated result from the official Shanghai Metro Route & Fare Inquiry (or another clearly documented official transit result). Record start station, end station, planned time, transfers, fare and estimated duration; otherwise leave the one-hour count blank.

suggestions.title: Use hotel dining as a shortlist, not a citywide cluster score
suggestions.text: T’ang Court, Bao Li Xuan, Yi Long Court and Jin Xuan are verified hotel-property Michelin-star options in the 2026 edition. Their convenient location may help, but this does not establish the number of other starred or Guide-listed restaurants reachable within one hour by transit.

suggestions.title: Schedule museum visits around the published weekly closures
suggestions.text: The current pages show People’s Square closed Mondays and Shanghai Museum East closed Tuesdays. The sample-week calendar below maps those rules to 2027 dates; reconfirm the museum announcements, evening sessions and exhibition ticket rules before travel.

suggestions.title: Check Taian Table availability now if it is a priority
suggestions.text: Its FAQ says reservations are accepted up to 90 days ahead. On 25 November 2026, the sample stay dates are 82–89 days away. This makes the dates fall within the published booking window, but no seat availability or confirmed reservation was checked.

suggestions.title: Recheck prices, awards and activity calendars closer to the trip
suggestions.text: The menus are 2026 snapshots, Michelin status is the 2026 edition, and activity pages do not provide exact February 2027 ticket prices/hours for all venues. Reconfirm official menus, reservations, attraction schedules and any hotel renovation notices before payment.
